durable delivery evidence for schedule-driven sends.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eLegacy workspace cwd migration.\u003c/strong\u003e Scheduled reruns and reused schedule sessions pinned to a pre-migration workspace root (e.g. \u003ccode\u003e~/.swarmclaw/workspace\u003c/code\u003e) are now rebound to the current \u003ccode\u003eWORKSPACE_DIR\u003c/code\u003e automatically; intentional custom working directories are never touched.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOrphan recovery dedup.\u003c/strong\u003e Startup queue recovery now recovers each orphaned task once instead of re-logging it every tick, and dead-letters tasks that repeatedly return to the queue without starting.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSchedule delivery status.\u003c/strong\u003e Every scheduled run now writes \u003ccode\u003elastDeliveryStatus\u003c/code\u003e/\u003ccode\u003elastDeliveryError\u003c/code\u003e back to its schedule, so failures are visible without digging through task records.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCredential preflight for schedules.\u003c/strong\u003e Scheduled runs on API-key providers fail fast with an actionable error when no credential resolves, instead of dying on a 401 deep in execution.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eEmpty-run classification.\u003c/strong\u003e Runs that produce no text, no tool calls, and no error now fail with a clear provider-configuration message instead of a generic validation failure.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eDurable connector delivery evidence.\u003c/strong\u003e Task follow-up sends route through the connector outbox with task/schedule linkage, retries with backoff, and per-run dedupe, so triage can prove whether a scheduled send succeeded, failed, or was never attempted.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRegression coverage.\u003c/strong\u003e Added tests for workspace path normalization, orphan recovery, schedule outcome writes, credential preflight, empty-run classification, and outbox-backed follow-ups.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 dir=\"auto\"\u003eScheduled-run reliability release: stale workspace rebinding, fail-fast credential checks, and durable delivery evidence for schedule-driven sends.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eLegacy workspace cwd migration.\u003c/strong\u003e Scheduled reruns and reused schedule sessions pinned to a pre-migration workspace root (e.g. \u003ccode\u003e~/.swarmclaw/workspace\u003c/code\u003e) are now rebound to the current \u003ccode\u003eWORKSPACE_DIR\u003c/code\u003e automatically; intentional custom working directories are never touched.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOrphan recovery dedup.\u003c/strong\u003e Startup queue recovery now recovers each orphaned task once instead of re-logging it every tick, and dead-letters tasks that repeatedly return to the queue without starting.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSchedule delivery status.\u003c/strong\u003e Every scheduled run now writes \u003ccode\u003elastDeliveryStatus\u003c/code\u003e/\u003ccode\u003elastDeliveryError\u003c/code\u003e back to its schedule, so failures are visible without digging through task records.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCredential preflight for schedules.\u003c/strong\u003e Scheduled runs on API-key providers fail fast with an actionable error when no credential resolves, instead of dying on a 401 deep in execution.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eEmpty-run classification.\u003c/strong\u003e Runs that produce no text, no tool calls, and no error now fail with a clear provider-configuration message instead of a generic validation failure.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eDurable connector delivery evidence.\u003c/strong\u003e Task follow-up sends route through the connector outbox with task/schedule linkage, retries with backoff, and per-run dedupe, so triage can prove whether a scheduled send succeeded, failed, or was never attempted.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRegression coverage.\u003c/strong\u003e Added tests for workspace path normalization, orphan recovery, schedule outcome writes, credential preflight, empty-run classification, and outbox-backed follow-ups.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch3 (\u003ccode\u003esrc/lib/providers/generic-cli.ts\u003c/code\u003e) spawns the configured binary with the prompt as final argv and emits stdout lines as SSE deltas.
